quotes.text: The benchmark spans one in-domain center and three out-of-domain (OOD) centers.

rationale: The paper names the source datasets and platforms at a high level. It does not report a task-to-source-record route on counted S1-S3 surfaces.

quotes.text: Due to licensing restrictions, we are unable to directly open-source the dataset.

rationale: The origin is stated and licensing restrictions are documented. The packet does not report consent or IRB status on counted surfaces.

quotes.text: we adopted a disease-wise sampling strategy.

rationale: The paper reports sampling designs and descriptive dataset statistics. It does not compare key patient features against a named target population on S1-S3.
searched: S1 paper and appendix, S2 README/docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 prompts. The packet does not report a dedicated unsafe-output test or bias test.

quotes.text: Measurement of verbatim overlap with public web corpora revealed zero exact matches between test tasks and public sources.

rationale: The paper reports developer-side contamination controls, including gated access and overlap measurement. That satisfies both a control and a measured check.

quotes.text: Web access is blocked during runs; retrieval is confined to the task environment

rationale: The packet states runtime isolation and names mechanisms: blocked web access and concealed labels. This supports agent isolation from gold information.

searched: S1 paper and appendix, S2 README/docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 prompts. The packet does not pin the benchmark environment with data, software, simulator, judge model, and harness version for reported results.

quotes.text: we ran a scripted reference solution for each task through the grader

rationale: The appendix reports scripted reference solutions run through the grader. It also reports that all 120 were graded correct.

quotes.text: checks both the intended state changes and that all other records remain unchanged

rationale: The packet reports that the grader checks both intended changes and unchanged records. The benchmark involves simulated clinical actions, so NA does not apply.
searched: S1 paper and appendix, S2 README/docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 prompts. Random or do-nothing success rates appear only in S4 comments, which do not count as reporting.
searched: S1 paper and appendix, S2 README/docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 prompts. No do-nothing or random-agent score is reported on S1-S3.

quotes.text: the LLM achieved near-perfect alignment with the human consensus

rationale: The benchmark validates its automated evaluator against physician annotations and reports agreement/error figures. This is validation on the benchmark’s own outputs.

quotes.text: All runs use temperature 0 and a fixed random seed, and each task is run three times

rationale: The packet reports deterministic settings and a repeated-run policy. There is an internal S1 inconsistency elsewhere about five runs at temperature 0.7, but G2 contradiction flags apply only to S4/S5 opposition.

quotes.text: Error bars show 95% confidence intervals.

rationale: Headline comparisons are accompanied by 95% confidence intervals and significance markers. This satisfies statistical comparison reporting.

quotes.text: five times per model with independent random seeds

rationale: The packet reports a run count per task, a seed policy, and independence of runs. The elements are all present on S1.

quotes.text: where several tasks share a patient, we resample patients instead to account for clustering.

rationale: The packet reports CIs, the bootstrap resampling unit, and clustering handling. All three required elements are present.

quotes.text: report pass^8, the fraction of tasks solved in all eight runs

rationale: The packet reports pass^8 and agreement of final environment state across eight runs. It does not separately report tool-action sequence agreement.

quotes.text: we utilize gpt-4o-2024-08-06 via API.

rationale: Exact model identifiers and decoding controls are reported. The harness commit or release tag matching the reported results is not reported.

quotes.text: Tools are specified using JSON schemas with name, arguments, and types.

rationale: The packet reports machine-readable schemas, side-effect documentation, and return/error semantics. It also says the descriptions are included in agent prompts, so S5 reach is marked true.

quotes.text: We ran conformance tests confirming that each tool behaves as documented.

rationale: The packet reports tool conformance checks and discloses simulated stubs. It states this disclosure is also in tool descriptions shown to the agent.

quotes.text: all returned examination results are simulated by the DiagGym

rationale: The benchmark includes clinical examination recommendations, which are simulated rather than executed. Scoring covers examination quality and efficiency, including unnecessary interaction turns; the S5 prompts do not clearly disclose simulation to the agent.

quotes.text: yielding 1% false acceptance and 2% false rejection rates.

rationale: The packet names grader inputs and reports validation with injected correct and incorrect outcomes. The non-state-grader rationale element is not needed for the end-state statement and is not independently present.

quotes.text: Released tasks include a canary string.

rationale: The packet reports blocked web access, a private held-out split with concealed labels, and canary strings. All three contamination-control elements are present.

quotes.text: by patient subgroup (sex, race), with case counts displayed for every slice

rationale: The packet reports task-family and patient-subgroup slice reporting with counts. That satisfies all three slice-reporting elements.

quotes.text: Researchers with valid CITI certification may also contact the authors directly for immediate access.

rationale: The packet states real EHR sources and separate data access terms from the code release. Governance is reported through credentialing/licensing restrictions and PhysioNet/CITI access requirements.
